query: For a 55‑year‑old female: among female ICU patients aged 50–60 with intracranial hemorrhage, report 25th, 50th (median), and 90th percentiles of procedure burden during the first 72 ICU hours, and compare ICU LOS and in‑hospital mortality to the general ICU.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icu_los, i.in_hospital_mortality_rate, percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY p.procedure_count) AS q25, percentile_cont(0.5) within GROUP (ORDER BY p.procedure_count) AS q50, percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY p.procedure_count) AS q90 FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60 AND p.anchor_year_group = 'Intracranial hemorrhage' AND i.intime <= '2020-01-01' AND (i.outtime >= '2020-01-01' OR i.outtime IS NULL) AND (p.dod >= '2020-01-01' OR p.dod IS NULL) GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icu_los, i.in_hospital_mortality_rate;
